identity_basis: Exact local working bytes and artifacts after the recorded commands, not a claim that HEAD includes uncommitted fixes.

environment.path_scope: Node directory prepended per process only; no nvm use or global switch

exit_observation: Exit statuses were observed in local command tool results; the capture script parses tests but does not infer typecheck exit from sparse logs.

source_delivery.remote_observation: Coordinator supplied merged PR and remote containment; this worker only read local fixed Git blobs, no network.

files.local_copy_exact: not copied; local importer independently composes same operations
